jobs.title: Product Manager, Product Management Application
jobs.description:
Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work, building a better and more sustainable world. Join our extraordinary team today!

The North America Application Equipment Product Manager leads the product strategy, roadmap, lifecycle management, and market performance of AGCO’s Application Equipment portfolio in North America. This includes RoGator®, TerraGator®, nutrient application systems, spraying technologies, and emerging precision application solutions. Acting as the voice of the customer and market, this role partners with Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, Manufacturing, Precision Ag, Agronomy, Sales, Dealers, and Customers to identify opportunities, define product requirements, prioritize investments, and deliver solutions that enhance customer productivity, sustainability, and profitability. The role is responsible for developing and executing regional product strategies aligned with AGCO’s global platform, technology, and brand strategies, and reports to the Director, Agronomy, Planting & Crop Care Product Management.

Your Impact

-
Lead the North America Application Equipment product strategy, roadmap, lifecycle management, and portfolio performance. Define short-, medium-, and long-term product plans for RoGator®, TerraGator®, nutrient application, spraying, and precision application technologies.

-
Identify market opportunities, customer needs, competitive threats, and emerging technology trends to guide portfolio decisions. Develop business cases, product investment proposals, and platform priorities that support profitable growth.

-
Lead structured Voice of Customer activities with growers, retailers, commercial applicators, dealers, and internal stakeholders. Translate customer insights and market feedback into clear product requirements, user stories, and development priorities.

-
Partner with Engineering, Precision Ag, Agronomy, Commercial, Marketing, Manufacturing, Sales, Dealers, and Customers to deliver market-relevant solutions. Support product development, launch readiness, dealer enablement, product training, customer demonstrations, and go-to-market execution.

-
Monitor market share, profitability, product performance, customer satisfaction, and competitive activity to recommend improvements. Ensure products deliver measurable value in productivity, input efficiency, application quality, sustainability, and customer profitability.

Your Experience and Qualifications

-
Bachelor's degree in agriculture, Agricultural Engineering, Agronomy, Agricultural Economics, Business, or related fields.

-
Minimum of 7 years’ experience in the agricultural equipment industry.

-
Proven experience in one or more of the following areas: product management, application equipment, precision agriculture, agronomy, product marketing, sales, technical support, or engineering.

-
Experience with application equipment, including self-propelled sprayers and nutrient application systems.

-
Experience working with dealers, large growers, product launches, and precision agriculture technologies.

Your Benefits

-
Health care and wellness plans

-
Dental and vision plans

-
401(k) Savings Plan with company match

-
Employee Stock Purchase Plan offering eligible employees the ability to purchase AGCO stock at a discounted price

-
Paid holidays and paid time off

-
Health savings and flexible spending accounts

-
Reimbursement for continuing education

-
Life insurance and other supplemental insurance plans

Your Compensation

This position offers a base salary range of $89,000 to $120,000, with final compensation determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for a target annual bonus eligibility of 15% of base salary, as part of AGCO’s total rewards program.

Your Workplace

This role follows AGCO’s on‑site work model, with employees primarily working from an AGCO USA location (Jackson, MN) for a 4 days per week to support collaboration and teamwork.

We value inclusion and recognize the innovation a diverse workforce delivers to our farmers. Through our recruitment efforts, we are committed to building a team that includes a variety of experiences, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.

Join our extraordinary team today and apply now!

AGCO is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.

Recruiter Scam Alert: AGCO has observed an increase in individuals impersonating AGCO recruiters. All legitimate AGCO recruiting communications are conducted only through official AGCO recruiters or AGCO authorized recruitment partners using official company email accounts (@agcocorp.com or .external@agcocorp.com). AGCO recruiters and partners will never use personal email addresses (such as Gmail, Yahoo, or similar). Any communication claiming to represent AGCO outside of these channels should be treated as fraudulent. All legitimate AGCO job opportunities are posted on our official career site at careers.agcocorp.com. Candidates are encouraged to apply directly through the site and maintain an active candidate profile.

jobs.title: Sr Product Owner, RPA & AI
jobs.description:
Do you want to help solve the world's most pressing challenges? Feeding the world's growing population and slowing climate change are two of the world's greatest challenges. AGCO is a part of the solution! Join us to make your contribution.

The Sr Product Owner, RPA & AI is responsible for identifying, shaping, and delivering automation and AI solutions that create measurable business value. Acting as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, the role owns the automation and AI portfolio backlog, roadmap, and value realization activities from opportunity identification through implementation and adoption.

Your Impact

-
Identify and prioritize automation opportunities across business functions, leveraging RPA, intelligent automation, and AI to drive efficiency and transformation.

-
Analyze and optimize business processes by assessing current and future states, ensuring processes are streamlined before automation implementation.

-
Manage automation and AI initiatives by owning the product backlog, roadmap, prioritization, business cases, ROI models, and value realization plans.

-
Bridge business and technology teams by translating requirements into user stories, partnering with stakeholders and technical teams, and driving adoption and change management.

-
Monitor, enhance, and scale solutions by tracking performance, compliance, user experience, benefits realization, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities while serving as a trusted advisor on process transformation and AI capabilities.

Your Experience and Qualifications

-
Bachelor's degree in business, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field

-
3+ years of experience in project management, business transformation, automation, process improvement, or related disciplines

-
Experience with Agile methodologies and backlog management tools

-
Knowledge of RPA platforms (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate, Automation Anywhere) and AI-enabled solutions

-
Experience building business cases and measuring business value.

Your Benefits

-
Attractive, fair remuneration including participation in our bonus scheme and reimbursement of commuting expenses

-
Cafeteria system with additional elements you can pick from

-
Balance of work, family and free time due to flexible working opportunity and the possibility of hybrid/remote work including home office monetary allowance

-
Private health insurance, dental services, and compensation for the purchase of computer monitor glasses

-
Employee Assistance Program including professional counselling, webinars, sports challenges, and newsletters

-
Development opportunities including monthly trainings held by the local training team and teacher guided language classes

Your Workplace

You will work with your amazing AGCO colleagues, spending two days onsite at our Budapest office and three days working from home.

AGCO Shared Service Center (SSC) is located at Office Garden in the 11th district, in one of the most dynamically developing areas of Budapest providing global support to all AGCO global factories and sites in Finance, HR, IT, Purchasing, Customer Experience and Engineering functions. The office is easily accessible by car and public transport. Restaurants, cafés, and a shopping centre are also located around the office.

We value inclusion and recognize the innovation a diverse workforce delivers to our farmers. Through our recruitment efforts, we are committed to building a team that includes a variety of experiences, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives.

Join us as we bring agriculture into the future and apply now!
